processes:task-ao-operate-verify-hd5dbn.plain_language_name: Check the Captured Time Before It Moves On

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in workforce management registers the authorized wind-down event and the scoped roster as the notification baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-ao-retire-transform-k39qn.plain_language_name: Give the Advance Notice the Law Requires
processes:task-ao-retire-transform-k39qn.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian issues the notices themselves: the statutory advance-notice filings are made and the individual notifications served to each affected employee, and the served-and-filed record is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-retire-transform-k39qn.business_purpose: It exists because the law gives people time to prepare for a reduction - the notice is that time, and serving it properly is the obligation.
processes:task-ao-retire-transform-k39qn.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be notified from, and it ends with the served and filed notices produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in workforce management serves each affected employee's notice and files the statutory advance notice, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-retire-verify-bwcuuj.plain_language_name: Check the Event and Roster Before the Notices Issue
processes:task-ao-retire-verify-bwcuuj.plain_language_description: Before any notice issues, the verification custodian checks the event and roster against what notification requires - that the reduction crosses the thresholds the controlling statute sets and the roster matches the authorized scope. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any notice is served.
processes:task-ao-retire-verify-bwcuuj.business_purpose: It exists so statutory notices never issue on an unauthorized event or a roster that overshoots it.
processes:task-ao-retire-verify-bwcuuj.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the roster running wider than the authorized scope and logs the defect before any notice issues.

processes:task-eo-activate-record-xtvzq8.plain_language_name: File the Operations Authorization Audit Record
processes:task-eo-activate-record-xtvzq8.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the acquisition trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-eo-activate-record-xtvzq8.business_purpose: It exists so the regulator's authorization can be evidenced, with its full history, whenever the authority to operate is questioned.
processes:task-eo-activate-record-xtvzq8.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record stored at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the authorization trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an authority-to-operate review would consult.

processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-kb792.plain_language_description: When the authorization stands obtained, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-kb792.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the issued authorization awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-eo-activate-transform-jth.plain_language_description: With the material verified, the processing custodian makes the acquisition itself: the application is filed, the regulator's authorization or certification is obtained, and the issued authorization is preserved on the regulated operations record in the form the activity defines. processes:task-eo-activate-verify-5f2mhx.plain_language_description: Before anything is filed, the verification custodian checks the material against what the application requires - that the description is complete and the filing follows the regulator's mandated format exactly. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the filing is made.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-5f2mhx.business_purpose: It exists so the regulator never receives an application that would fail on form or completeness.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-5f2mhx.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the material can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the filing drifting from the mandated format and logs the defect before anything goes to the regulator.

processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-te846.plain_language_description: When the notification stands issued, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-te846.business_purpose: It exists so live operations proceed only once the notification is confirmed as issued.
processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-te846.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the issued notification awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the issued notification against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the oversight chain needs.

processes:task-eo-activate-intake-wh52hu.plain_language_name: Receive the Authorization and the Supervisor Relationship

processes:task-eo-activate-transform-9fh.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian makes the activation itself: the continuing-supervisor notification is activated under the regulator's continuing oversight, and the issued notification is set down on the regulated operations record in the form the activity defines. processes:task-eo-activate-transform-9fh.business_purpose: It exists because an authorization is not the end - live operations run under continuing oversight, and the notification is where that oversight begins.
processes:task-eo-activate-transform-9fh.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be activated from, and it ends with the issued notification produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian activates the continuing-supervisor notification under the oversight regime and records it on the regulated operations record.

processes:task-eo-activate-verify-8t3bqv.plain_language_name: Check the Authorization and Relationship Before Switching On
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-8t3bqv.plain_language_description: Before the notification is activated, the verification custodian checks the authorization and relationship against what activation requires - that the authorization covers the capability and the supervisor named is the one the oversight requires. Gaps are logged for rejection or repair before the switch is made.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-8t3bqv.business_purpose: It exists so continuing supervision never starts against the wrong authorization or the wrong supervisor.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-8t3bqv.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the supervisor named no longer holding the oversight role and logs the gap before the notification switches on.

processes:task-eo-activate-record-3x3jub.plain_language_name: File the Operational Controls Audit Record
processes:task-eo-activate-record-3x3jub.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the go-live trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. processes:task-eo-activate-record-3x3jub.business_purpose: It exists so the control arrangement behind live operations can be evidenced whenever its adequacy is examined.
processes:task-eo-activate-record-3x3jub.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record held at its tier and retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the go-live trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a controls review would consult.

processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-2r3mq.plain_language_description: When the controls stand live, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-2r3mq.business_purpose: It exists so live operations proceed only once the controls are confirmed as live.
processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-2r3mq.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the live controls await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

processes:task-eo-activate-intake-nne7az.plain_language_name: Receive the Control Framework and the Authorization

The intake custodian accepts both, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the bring-live work from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-activate-intake-nne7az.business_purpose: It exists so controls go live from the mandated framework over an issued authorization, not from local improvisation.
processes:task-eo-activate-intake-nne7az.practical_context: It opens when the control framework and authorization are presented for the bring-live, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the operations function registers the mandated control framework and the authorization as the bring-live baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-eo-activate-transform-swx.plain_language_description: With the framework verified, the processing custodian makes the go-live itself: each operational control is brought live and recorded onto the regulated operations record in the form the activity defines. Working papers from the launch are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-activate-transform-swx.business_purpose: It exists because controls on paper restrain nothing - the go-live is where the authorization starts to mean operational safety.
processes:task-eo-activate-transform-swx.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified framework is ready to be brought live, and it ends with the controls live and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the operations function brings each mandated control live and records the arrangement onto the regulated operations record.

processes:task-eo-activate-verify-cyg5gt.plain_language_name: Check the Framework Before Bringing the Controls Live
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-cyg5gt.plain_language_description: Before any control is brought live, the verification custodian checks the framework against what the go-live requires - that every mandated control is present and each is traceable to the authorization. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any control is switched on.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-cyg5gt.business_purpose: It exists so live operations never run on controls that only partially match what the regulator mandated.
processes:task-eo-activate-verify-cyg5gt.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the framework can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds a mandated control with no implementation behind it and logs the defect before any control goes live.

processes:task-eo-activate-record-nu4fn2.business_purpose: It exists so the authoritative document set behind live operations can be evidenced whenever its currency is examined.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the manuals trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a document review would consult.

processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-c5adq.business_purpose: It exists so operations run only once the manuals are confirmed as live.
processes:task-eo-activate-confirm-c5adq.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the live manuals await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the live manuals against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation live operations wait on.
